name: jev-axi
verified_notes: Verified against the installed CLI on 2026-09-22, not from the README. `jev-axi hook pre-tool-use` reads the hook JSON on stdin and exits 0 in every case; the decision is on stdout. Default output prints NOTHING for allow, so --explain is used instead: it prints `decision:`, `source:` and `reason:` as key-value lines. `source` is load-bearing -- it is `local` for the deterministic fast path (read-only commands, the project's own tests and builds, edits inside the project, all decided with no API call), `error` when the key is missing or Jev is unreachable, and the default --on-error policy is ALLOW. Without treating `source: error` as an error, a dead key reads as a clean sheet of allows. Observed verbatim: `decision: allow / source: error / error: TYPESAFE_API_KEY is not set`. Addressed by absolute path: each case runs with cwd and HOME on a throwaway dir, so `npx` cannot resolve the local install.
